class/ApprovalExpired.when: An approval or a drafted plan is older than approval_ttl.
class/ApprovalExpired.do: Create a new plan and ask the person to approve it. Nothing renews an old approval.

class/BcfError.when: A BCF file or its path is unsafe or invalid: no workspace, path outside the workspace, bad zip entry or an oversized entry.
class/BcfError.do: Use a BCF file inside the workspace. Do not open archives from untrusted sources.

class/BridgeError.when: Communication with the Revit bridge failed, or a tool reported a failure. Returned to clients as kind bridge_error.
class/BridgeError.do: Run revit_health and check that Revit is running with the add-in.

class/CategoryMismatch.when: A family spec uses a category that does not fit its port kinds.
class/CategoryMismatch.do: Pick a category that fits the port kinds or fix the ports. Nothing was sent to Revit.

class/CommandFailed.when: Revit ran the command and it failed. Only this error marks an in-flight approved action as failed.
class/CommandFailed.do: Read the attached result. Plan a corrected action; the old approval is used up.

class/CursorError.when: A read cursor is malformed, unknown, expired, past the end or belongs to another call. Returned to clients as kind invalid_cursor.
class/CursorError.do: Call the tool again without a cursor, or repeat the first call's tool, arguments and fields exactly with the cursor.

class/DomainMismatch.when: A system belongs to a different domain than the tool's kind.
class/DomainMismatch.do: Pick a system of the tool's kind, for example pipe systems for pipes.

class/InstanceRoutingError.when: A panel request cannot be routed to exactly one running Revit.
class/InstanceRoutingError.do: Pass instance with the integer pid of the Revit process, or leave only one Revit open.

class/PanelTokenError.when: The panel token file is unusable. The message never contains the token.
class/PanelTokenError.do: Ask the person to restart the server and panel so a new token is written (docs/troubleshooting.md).

class/PolicyError.when: The workspace policy file is invalid, or a plan breaks one of its rules. All writes are refused while the file is invalid.
class/PolicyError.do: Change the plan to fit the policy, or ask the person to fix or relax the policy file (docs/security.md).

class/QueryError.when: A snapshot_compute pipeline is malformed: an unknown key, op, join or aggregate, a missing value, a bad 'from', or a limit exceeded. The message names the step.
class/QueryError.do: Fix the step the message names and call again. Nothing was read from Revit or written.

class/ReadModeViolation.when: A script marked mode read contains something that could change the model.
class/ReadModeViolation.do: Remove the model-changing code, or run the script as a write that goes through a plan.

class/RecipeError.when: A recipe request is refused. It carries a machine kind; those are listed under result kinds.
class/RecipeError.do: Look up the kind in this file.

class/ResourceError.when: An MCP resource URI is unknown, malformed or names an id that is not allowed.
class/ResourceError.do: List resources and use an exact URI.

class/RevitMCPError.when: Base class of the server's own errors. Not raised directly.
class/RevitMCPError.do: Handle the subclass named in the message.

class/SchemaValidationError.when: Inputs failed the tool's declared JSON schema.
class/SchemaValidationError.do: Fix the argument the message names and call again.

class/ToolProfileBlocked.when: A registered tool is hidden by the static MCP tool profile. Returned as kind tool_profile_blocked.
class/ToolProfileBlocked.do: Use a listed tool, or ask the person to change the profile.

class/WorkspaceViolation.when: A tool targeted a path outside the allowed workspace directories, or a module wrote a file its manifest does not allow.
class/WorkspaceViolation.do: Use a path inside the workspace (revit_get_context shows it). Do not try to reach other folders.

kind/already_on_circuit.when: The element is already on a circuit that the tool did not make.
kind/already_on_circuit.do: The element is on a circuit this tool did not make. Remove it from that circuit in Revit first; this tool never moves elements between circuits. Nothing was changed.

kind/annotation_crop_unreadable.when: Revit gave no annotation crop for the reference view.
kind/annotation_crop_unreadable.do: Revit did not give the annotation crop of the reference view. Use annotation_crop on, off or keep instead.

kind/approval_required.when: A module write tool was called without an approved plan, or the approved action does not match the call.
kind/approval_required.do: The approval gate refused the call. Nothing was sent to Revit.

kind/baseline_not_found.when: A comparison names a baseline snapshot that does not exist.
kind/baseline_not_found.do: List the saved baselines with the same tool, or take a new snapshot first. Nothing was changed.

kind/baseline_not_saved.when: The baseline snapshot could not be written to the workspace.
kind/baseline_not_saved.do: Check that the workspace folder is writable and has space, then take the snapshot again.

kind/binding_required.when: A recipe write was planned without the recipe version and sha256.
kind/binding_required.do: Pass version and sha256 from revit_recipe_get (or a dry_run) so the approval covers exactly this code. Nothing was sent to Revit.

kind/bindings_unreadable.when: Revit would not list the project's parameter bindings.
kind/bindings_unreadable.do: Revit would not list the project's parameter bindings; nothing was changed. Check revit_health and try again.

kind/bridge_error.when: The call to Revit failed: no connection, a lost reply or an expired request id.
kind/bridge_error.do: Run revit_health and check that Revit is running with the AEC Model Bridge add-in and a project open. After a write, check the model before repeating it.

kind/category_mismatch.when: The family category does not fit the connector kinds of its ports.
kind/category_mismatch.do: Use a category whose connectors fit the ports (mech: pipe/duct, plumb: pipe, air: duct, elec_eq/elec_fx/light: elec), or fix the port kinds. Nothing was sent to Revit.

kind/code_too_large.when: Recipe code is larger than 64 KiB.
kind/code_too_large.do: Shorten the recipe code to 64 KiB or less.

kind/conflicting_values.when: One call gives the same element two different values for one parameter.
kind/conflicting_values.do: The same element got two different values for one parameter (two items, or two instances of one type with scope 'type'). Nothing was changed.

kind/connector_in_use.when: The chosen connector is already connected.
kind/connector_in_use.do: That connector is connected to something else. Choose another with near_m, sort or index. Nothing was changed.

kind/connector_not_found.do: No connector matches the filters. Loosen diameter_mm, sort, index or near_m. Nothing was changed.

kind/crop_not_rectangular.when: The view crop region is not a rectangle.
kind/crop_not_rectangular.do: This tool copies and sets rectangular crop regions only. Reset the custom crop shape in Revit first.

kind/crossing_not_found.when: A crossing id is not in the current crossing list.
kind/crossing_not_found.do: Run revit_sparing_find with the same filters and use crossing_id values from its rows. Nothing was changed.

kind/document_mismatch.when: The active document is not the one the baseline was saved from.
kind/document_mismatch.do: Open the model the baseline came from, or save a new baseline for this one.

kind/domain_mismatch.when: The system or family does not belong to the tool's domain (pipe, duct, cable tray).
kind/domain_mismatch.do: The system and the tool do not belong together (or the family has connectors of another domain only). Pick a system of the tool's kind: pipe systems for pipes, air systems for ducts. Nothing was changed.

kind/dry_run_not_honoured.when: A dry run reported committed changes.
kind/dry_run_not_honoured.do: A dry run reported committed changes. Check the elements with revit_get_parameters before doing anything else.

kind/duplicate_circuit_id.when: Two circuits in one call share an id.
kind/duplicate_circuit_id.do: Give every circuit in the call its own id. Nothing was changed.

kind/duplicate_connection_id.when: Two connections in one call share an id.
kind/duplicate_connection_id.do: Give every connection in the call its own id. Nothing was changed.

kind/duplicate_route_id.when: Two routes in one call share an id.
kind/duplicate_route_id.do: Give every route in the call its own id. Nothing was changed.

kind/duplicate_sheet.when: A sheet is listed twice in the table.
kind/duplicate_sheet.do: List each sheet once in the table.

kind/duplicate_view.do: List each view once; a view can be on a sheet once.

kind/element_in_two_circuits.when: An element is listed on two circuits of one system.
kind/element_in_two_circuits.do: An element can be on one circuit of a system. Nothing was changed.

kind/element_not_found.when: An element id does not exist in the active document.
kind/element_not_found.do: Check the element ids (revit_get_parameters or a selector finds them). Nothing was changed.

kind/element_not_in_view.when: An element has no extent in the chosen view.
kind/element_not_in_view.do: Give elements that are visible in that view (they need an extent in it), or pick another view.

kind/empty_circuit.do: List at least one element. Nothing was changed.

kind/empty_extent.when: The revision cloud would have no extent.
kind/empty_extent.do: Raise margin_mm so the cloud has an extent.

kind/empty_output.when: A recipe ran but printed nothing.
kind/empty_output.do: End the recipe with __output__ = run_main(main) and call summary() and row().

kind/empty_selection.do: The selector matched nothing. Check category, name, level and tag with revit_get_parameters. Nothing was changed.

kind/export_failed.do: Revit refused the export. Check the options (sheet numbers, view ids) and that the folder is writable.

kind/exporter_unavailable.when: NWC export was asked for but the Navisworks exporter is not installed in Revit.
kind/exporter_unavailable.do: The Navisworks exporter add-in must be installed in this Revit for NWC export; use ifc instead.

kind/facing_same_way.when: The two connectors to join point the same way.
kind/facing_same_way.do: The two connectors point the same way. Check the pieces; nothing was changed.

kind/family_exists.when: A family with that name is already loaded in the project.
kind/family_exists.do: Pass replace=true to load over the family in the project, or choose another name.

kind/family_has_connectors.when: The hanger family has MEP connectors.
kind/family_has_connectors.do: A family with MEP connectors is a valve or fitting, not a hanger. Use a hanger family without connectors. Nothing was changed.

kind/family_not_found.when: The named family or type is not loaded in the project.
kind/family_not_found.do: Load the sparing family into the project first and use the exact family and type names listed in the message. Nothing was changed.

kind/file_exists.when: The target file exists and overwrite is not set.
kind/file_exists.do: Pass overwrite=true to replace the file, or choose another path.

kind/file_not_found.when: The IFC file path does not exist.
kind/file_not_found.do: Export first with revit_export (format ifc), then pass the same path.

kind/flow_mismatch.when: Both connectors have the same flow direction.
kind/flow_mismatch.do: Both connectors have the same flow direction (both In or both Out). Pick the other connector. Nothing was changed.

kind/group_close_failed.when: The transaction group around a family build could not be confirmed closed.
kind/group_close_failed.do: The project transaction group could not be confirmed closed. Inspect the project before retrying. BACKUP_RETAINED and FILE_NOT_RESTORED messages report original backup paths; do not discard those backups until the project and output files are reconciled.

kind/hanger_category_mismatch.when: The hanger family is in a category the tool does not accept.
kind/hanger_category_mismatch.do: The hanger family must be in Generic Models, Pipe Accessories, Duct Accessories, Cable Tray Fittings or Specialty Equipment. Pick another family or fix its category in the family editor. Nothing was changed.

kind/hash_mismatch.when: The recipe code and manifest files disagree on the sha256.
kind/hash_mismatch.do: The recipe files do not agree. Nothing was run. Save the recipe again with revit_recipe_save, then read its new sha256 with revit_recipe_get.

kind/host_not_found.when: A host element id is not in the active document.
kind/host_not_found.do: The spec names hosts by element id; they must exist in the active document. Check you are in the right model, or use on_error=skip to place the rest. Nothing was changed.

kind/ifc_unreadable.when: ifcopenshell cannot open the IFC file.
kind/ifc_unreadable.do: The file is not an IFC that ifcopenshell can open. Export it again with revit_export; nothing was compared (UNVERIFIED).

kind/illegal_transition.when: A requested status move is not allowed from the current status.
kind/illegal_transition.do: Nothing was changed. The allowed moves are in the result's transitions table: proposed > requested > approved or rejected; approved > built or rejected; rejected > proposed. Move step by step.

kind/invalid_id.when: A recipe id has characters or a length that is not allowed.
kind/invalid_id.do: Ids use a-z, 0-9, '_' and '-' (1 to 64 characters).

kind/invalid_input.when: An argument is missing, has the wrong type or is out of range.
kind/invalid_input.do: Fix the argument named in the message and call again. Nothing was sent to Revit.

kind/invalid_params.when: Recipe parameter values do not match the recipe schema.
kind/invalid_params.do: Fix the parameter values named in the message (revit_recipe_get shows the schema). Nothing was sent to Revit.

kind/joint_needs_curves.when: A curve based joint was asked for between pieces that have no curves.
kind/joint_needs_curves.do: Use joint 'direct' (or 'auto') to join equipment. Nothing was changed.

kind/level_not_found.when: The named level does not exist.
kind/level_not_found.do: List the levels with revit_list_levels and use the exact name.

kind/link_not_found.when: The link id is not a loaded link instance.
kind/link_not_found.do: force_link_id must be a loaded link instance (see the links in the spec). Nothing was changed.

kind/manifest_invalid.when: A stored recipe has an invalid manifest.
kind/manifest_invalid.do: Save the recipe again with revit_recipe_save. The message names the invalid manifest fields.

kind/missing_parameter.when: The sparing family lacks a parameter the call names.
kind/missing_parameter.do: The family lacks the instance parameters named in size_parameters or status_parameter. Use names from the list in the message (or add the parameters to the family). Nothing was changed.

kind/name_conflict.when: An element the tool did not make already has that name.
kind/name_conflict.do: Choose another name. This tool replaces only elements it made under the same tag and name, and never touches others; delete or rename the existing one yourself if it is really yours.

kind/no_bindable_category.when: The chosen categories cannot hold bound parameters.
kind/no_bindable_category.do: Pick categories that allow bound parameters (genericmodels, specialtyequipment ...). Nothing was changed.

kind/no_bridge.when: A module tool ran without the server's tool registry.
kind/no_bridge.do: This tool must run inside the AEC Model Bridge server (module provider with a tool registry).

kind/no_connectors.when: The family has no pipe, duct or electrical connectors.
kind/no_connectors.do: Fix or replace the family so it has connectors of the right kind. Nothing was changed.

kind/no_free_connector.when: Every matching connector is already connected.
kind/no_free_connector.do: Every matching connector is already connected. Free one, choose another system, or replace the route that uses it (same tag and id). Nothing was changed.

kind/no_layout_area.when: The sheet has no area to lay views out in.
kind/no_layout_area.do: Give area_mm, or x_mm and y_mm for every view, or put a title block on the sheet.

kind/no_workspace.do: Ask the person to set a workspace folder (see docs/configuration-reference.md).

kind/not_coincident.when: The two connectors are not at the same place.
kind/not_coincident.do: This tool does not move or route anything. Use revit_mep_route to run a pipe or duct between the two connectors. Nothing was changed.

kind/not_found.when: The recipe id does not exist.
kind/not_found.do: revit_recipe_list shows the recipes that exist.

kind/not_straight.when: A hanger was asked for on a curved or non-straight run.
kind/not_straight.do: Only straight pipes, ducts and cable trays carry hangers. Nothing was changed.

kind/not_write.when: An approval was asked for a recipe saved as read.
kind/not_write.do: Run the read recipe directly. It needs no approval.

kind/nothing_to_place.when: No crossing needs a sparing with the given filters.
kind/nothing_to_place.do: No crossing needs a sparing with these filters. Nothing was changed.

kind/number_conflict.when: A sheet with that number exists and the tool did not make it.
kind/number_conflict.do: Choose another sheet number, or delete the existing sheet yourself. This tool never touches sheets it did not make.

kind/panel_category.when: The panel family is not an Electrical Equipment family.
kind/panel_category.do: The panel must be an Electrical Equipment family. Nothing was changed.

kind/panel_in_circuit.when: The panel is also in the element list of its own circuit.
kind/panel_in_circuit.do: Remove the panel from the element list. Nothing was changed.

kind/parameter_refused.when: A parameter cannot be written: read only, wrong storage type or wrong unit.
kind/parameter_refused.do: Nothing was changed. Read the reason per element in rows (status refused): use revit_get_parameters to see the parameter names, units and which ones are writable, fix the items, or pass on_error='skip' to write the others.

kind/partial_failure.when: Some steps worked and others failed, and the call did not roll back.
kind/partial_failure.do: The elements that worked were written (see changed_ids and rows with status set); refused or failed ones are in fails and rows. Use revert to undo the written values.

kind/path_outside_workspace.when: A path is outside the allowed workspace directories.
kind/path_outside_workspace.do: Use a path inside the allowed workspace directories (see revit_get_context for the workspace folder).

kind/placement_failed.when: Revit could not place the sparing or family instance.
kind/placement_failed.do: Revit could not place the first sparing (wrong placement type, no host face, host in a link for a hosted family). Nothing was changed.

kind/placement_unsupported.when: The hanger family uses a placement type the tool does not support.
kind/placement_unsupported.do: Only level based (unhosted) hanger families are placed; face based, work plane based and hosted families are not. Pick or make a level based one. Nothing was changed.

kind/position_off_run.when: A hanger position is more than 25 mm from its run axis.
kind/position_off_run.do: Each position must lie on the axis of its run (within 25 mm). Take the positions from revit_mep_hanger_plan unchanged. Nothing was changed.

kind/post_check_failed.when: A value read back after the write differs from the value written.
kind/post_check_failed.do: A value did not read back as written (see post_check). Inspect the element with revit_get_parameters; use revert to put the old values back.

kind/read_mode_violation.when: A recipe saved as read contains code that read mode refuses.
kind/read_mode_violation.do: A recipe saved as read must pass read mode. Save it again with mode 'write' (it will then need an approved plan) or remove what read mode names.

kind/recipe_changed.when: The recipe differs from the version and sha256 that were planned.
kind/recipe_changed.do: The recipe is not the one that was planned. Read it again with revit_recipe_get; a changed recipe needs a new plan with the new version and sha256. Nothing was sent to Revit.

kind/recipe_incomplete.when: A stored recipe is missing its manifest or code file.
kind/recipe_incomplete.do: Save the recipe again with revit_recipe_save, or delete it and recreate it.

kind/recipe_too_large.when: A stored recipe is larger than the size limits.
kind/recipe_too_large.do: Shorten the recipe code and parameter lists, then save again.

kind/recipe_unreadable.when: A stored recipe file cannot be read.
kind/recipe_unreadable.do: Check the workspace recipe folder for permission or disk problems, then save the recipe again.

kind/reference_crop_off.when: The reference view has its crop region switched off.
kind/reference_crop_off.do: Switch the crop region of the reference view on first, then call again.

kind/revision_exists.when: The revision is already in the document.
kind/revision_exists.do: That revision is already in the document. Use its id, or give another description or date.

kind/revision_issued.when: The revision is issued and cannot take new clouds.
kind/revision_issued.do: An issued revision cannot get new clouds. Add a new revision with revit_add_revision and use that.

kind/revision_not_found.when: The revision id or number does not exist.
kind/revision_not_found.do: Use a revision id or revision number listed by revit_list_revisions.

kind/rolled_back.when: A step failed and the whole call was rolled back.
kind/rolled_back.do: Nothing was changed: the whole call was rolled back. Fix the cause named in fails and call again, or pass on_error='skip' to keep what worked.

kind/same_element.when: Two arguments that must differ name the same element.
kind/same_element.do: a and b must be different elements. Nothing was changed.

kind/script_error.when: The Revit add-in reported a script error before any result was produced.
kind/script_error.do: The add-in failed before the script produced a result. Read the message. For a write tool, check the model before repeating the call.

kind/script_exception.when: The embedded script raised an exception inside Revit.
kind/script_exception.do: A read-only call changed nothing. A write recipe may have committed changes before it failed: check the model before repeating it, and repeat it only through a new approved plan.

kind/shared_parameter_file_missing.when: Revit has no shared parameter file set and none was passed.
kind/shared_parameter_file_missing.do: Point Revit at the firm's shared parameter file (Manage > Shared Parameters) or pass shared_parameter_file, then call again. Nothing was changed.

kind/sheet_not_found.when: No sheet has that number, or more than one does.
kind/sheet_not_found.do: Make the sheet first with revit_make_sheet, or check the number with revit_sheet_index. A number must match exactly one sheet.

kind/sheet_not_owned.when: The sheet was not made by this tool.
kind/sheet_not_owned.do: Pass allow_foreign=true to add the schedule to a sheet this tool did not make.

kind/sheet_number_conflict.when: The table would give two sheets the same number.
kind/sheet_number_conflict.do: Choose numbers that no other sheet ends up with. This tool never renumbers sheets that are not in the table.

kind/starter_recipe.when: A built-in starter recipe was asked to be deleted or approved.
kind/starter_recipe.do: Starter recipes are read only. Save your own recipe with the same id to replace one.

kind/system_mismatch.when: The connectors belong to different systems, or the family has no connector of the system.
kind/system_mismatch.do: Pick connectors or a system of the same domain, or fix the family. Nothing was changed.

kind/system_type_not_found.when: The route has no start connector and no system type exists.
kind/system_type_not_found.do: Start the route at a connector, or create the system type in Revit first. Nothing was changed.

kind/tee_needs_owned_trunk.when: A tee was asked for on a trunk the tool did not make.
kind/tee_needs_owned_trunk.do: Use branch_to.route for a tee, or fitting 'takeoff' for a trunk given by ids. Nothing was changed.

kind/template_not_found.when: The view template name does not exist.
kind/template_not_found.do: Use one of the view template names listed in the message (revit_list_views_sheets_schedules with kinds ['templates']).

kind/timeout_running.when: The wait for Revit ran out while the script was still running.
kind/timeout_running.do: Revit may still be running the script. Call revit_get_result with the request_id.

kind/title_block_not_found.when: The title block type name does not exist.
kind/title_block_not_found.do: Use one of the title block type names listed in the message.

kind/too_many_elements.when: The call names more than 500 elements.
kind/too_many_elements.do: At most 500 elements per call. Narrow the selectors or split the call. Nothing was changed.

kind/too_many_hangers.when: The plan would place more hangers than max_hangers.
kind/too_many_hangers.do: Narrow the scope, or raise max_hangers (at most 500). Nothing was changed.

kind/too_many_recipes.when: The workspace already holds the maximum number of recipes.
kind/too_many_recipes.do: Delete recipes you no longer need with revit_recipe_delete, then save again.

kind/too_many_sparings.when: The call would place more sparings than max_sparings.
kind/too_many_sparings.do: Narrow the call with level, system, ids or crossing_ids, or raise max_sparings (at most 500). Nothing was changed.

kind/too_many_values.when: The call holds more parameter values than one call may carry.
kind/too_many_values.do: Split the call into smaller batches. Nothing was changed.

kind/trunk_not_found.when: A branch names a trunk route or pipe that does not exist.
kind/trunk_not_found.do: Build the trunk route first (earlier in the same call, or an earlier call with the same tag), or list real pipe or duct ids. Nothing was changed.

kind/type_not_found.when: The pipe or duct type name does not exist.
kind/type_not_found.do: Use one of the pipe or duct type names listed in the message. Nothing was changed.

kind/unparsable_output.when: The script printed no summary the server can read.
kind/unparsable_output.do: The add-in may run a different IronPython engine. Run revit_health, check the add-in version against the server, and report a bug if it persists.

kind/view_already_placed.when: The view is already on another sheet.
kind/view_already_placed.do: A view can be on one sheet only. Remove its viewport from the other sheet yourself or make a duplicate view first; this tool never moves a placed view.

kind/view_not_found.when: A view id or name does not exist.
kind/view_not_found.do: Check the view ids or names with revit_list_views_sheets_schedules.

kind/view_not_plan.when: A non-plan view was given to a tool that takes plan views.
kind/view_not_plan.do: Only plan views take part. Pick floor, ceiling or area plans (revit_list_views_sheets_schedules).

kind/view_not_supported.when: The view type cannot hold revision clouds.
kind/view_not_supported.do: Clouds go into plan, section and elevation views. Pick one of those.

kind/wrong_document.when: The active document is not the discipline model the tool needs.
kind/wrong_document.do: The bridge works on the active document only. Open the discipline model named in the message, make it the active document, and call again. Nothing was changed.

mcp/approval_blocked.when: The approval gate refused a call that changes the model: no approved plan, a plan that does not match, an expired approval, a policy rule, or a changed document.
mcp/approval_blocked.do: Read the message. Create a plan with plan_actions, ask the person to approve it, then run it with execute_plan. Do not retry the same call unchanged.

mcp/bridge_error.when: The server could not reach Revit, lost the reply, or Revit ran the command and it failed.
mcp/bridge_error.do: Run revit_health. Check that Revit is open with the add-in and a project loaded. After a failed write, read the attached result before planning again.

mcp/execution_error.when: A tool raised an error that is not one of the kinds above, for example bad arguments or a file problem.
mcp/execution_error.do: Read the message and fix the arguments. If it repeats with valid arguments, report a bug with the log (docs/troubleshooting.md).

mcp/human_only.when: An AI client called approve_plan, reject_plan or rollback_plan.
mcp/human_only.do: Stop. Ask the person to approve, reject or roll back the plan in the Revit panel or with the aec-model-bridge-approve command.

mcp/invalid_cursor.when: response_options.cursor was refused: it expired (default 600 seconds), the server restarted, it came from another call, or the tool takes no cursor.
mcp/invalid_cursor.do: Call the tool again without a cursor and page from the new answer.

mcp/invalid_response_options.when: The response_options argument is not an object, names an unsupported key, or has a value of the wrong type.
mcp/invalid_response_options.do: Remove response_options or fix it as the message says, then call again.

mcp/tool_profile_blocked.when: The tool is registered but this server's static MCP tool profile hides it.
mcp/tool_profile_blocked.do: Use a tool the profile lists. To use this one, the person must change the tool profile and restart the server (docs/mcp-token-budget.md).

mcp/unknown_tool.when: The tool name is not registered in this server.
mcp/unknown_tool.do: Call tools/list and use an exact name. A module tool is missing when its module is off or failed to load.
